title: Systemic Risk and Default Cascades in Global Equity Markets: A Network and Tail-Risk Approach Based on the Gai Kapadia Framework
summary: This study extends the Gai-Kapadia framework, originally developed for interbank contagion, to assess systemic risk and default cascades in global equity markets. We analyze a 30 asset network comprising Brazilian and developed market equities over the period 2015-2026, constructing exposure based financial networks from price co-movements. Threshold filtering (theta = 0.3 and theta = 0.5) is applied to isolate significant interconnections.
